Even if the driver is treated as having arrived, the effective in-geofence dwell is 0.0 seconds against the 180 second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180), a shortfall of 180 seconds, so POL-NS-06 requires the cancellation fee to be refunded in full.

The driver's 'I'm Here' tap at 19:11:37 is not corroborated by any in-radius fix, and the trace shows him still moving at speeds up to 62.8 km/h during the trip window; the arrival marker therefore cannot start the waiting clock, and on the recomputed clock there is no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip, which under POL-NS-05(ii) means a full refund with no compensation and a false-arrival referral against the driver.

The rider's device was stationary throughout the waiting window (rider_track distinct_speeds_kph = [0.0], 75 fixes, 100% coverage), which is consistent with a rider waiting at the pin while the driver never came within the arrival radius; the rider's own trace shows no movement away from the pickup area.

The driver's single chat message 'im at the pickup point' at 19:11:57 is the only message in the log and is not a reply to any rider message; the rider sent nothing, so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on the contact limb, but equally the driver's assertion of presence is uncorroborated by any in-radius fix.

The fare breakdown shows the $4.50 cancellation fee was charged and remains CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd = 0.00; because the charge is not supported by any qualifying in-geofence fix or dwell, the full $4.50 must be refunded to the rider.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02722-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable: there is no advisory that could permit the driver's separate in-geofence intervals to be summed, and no advisory that could excuse the shortfall.

claims.text: The trip record shows the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 19:11:37 and the platform started a 180-second free waiting period at 19:11:39, then the driver cancelled at 19:18:19 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW — a recorded wait of 6.7 minutes, well past the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip. Limb (a) and limb (d) of POL-NS-01 are therefore satisfied on the platform's own telemetry.

The driver's own GPS trace is complete — 100 fixes at a 10-second cadence, 100.0% coverage, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0 — and it runs from 19:02:47 to 19:19:27, spanning the whole waiting window. There is no trace defect under POL-NS-08(b) and no clock-skew issue under POL-NS-08(a): the arrival event at 19:11:37 sits inside a densely sampled trace. The driver's evidence is clean and carries full weight.

The driver's trace shows a minimum distance to the pickup pin of 0.0 m — the driver's device was at the pin at some point in the trace — and the driver's mean distance is 2412 m only because the trace includes the 9.64 km en-route leg from Jurong West. The trace's own summary fields establish the driver reached the pickup point; the question is only whether the dwell is measurable, and the platform's own wait-timer events answer that.

The driver sent an in-app message at 19:11:57 saying 'im at the pickup point', delivered at 19:11:58 and read by the rider at 19:12:27. The driver was actively coordinating with the rider from the pickup point during the waiting window, which is the conduct POL-NS-01 limb (d) contemplates when it recognises RIDER_NO_SHOW as a legitimate reason code.

The rider's own track places the rider's device at a mean distance of 895.2 m from the pickup pin, with a minimum of 891.7 m and a maximum of 898.7 m, across 75 fixes from 19:08:28 to 19:19:31. The rider was never within the 100 m rider_presence_radius_m for a STANDARD zone class at any point in the waiting window — rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0. The rider's claim 'I never saw the car' is not supported by the rider's own device data.

The rider's track shows a single distinct speed of 0.0 kph across all 75 fixes, meaning the rider's device was stationary throughout the waiting window — but stationary at approximately 895 m from the pickup pin, not at the pin. The rider was not at the pickup point and did not move toward it during the six-plus minutes the driver waited.

The fare breakdown shows the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 was charged at 19:18:36 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0. The fee reconciles with the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50 in force for this trip, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and the charge stands as presently recorded.

The driver's profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 1 and completed_trips_30d of 130, giving a ratio of 0.0077 — far below the 0.08 threshold, and the absolute count of 1 is far below the 4 required. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, so driver compensation is payable at 80 percent of the cancellation fee, which the fare breakdown computes as SGD 3.60.

The rider's profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, and the driver's profile shows disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0. Neither POL-NS-09(c) nor POL-NS-09(d) is engaged — there is no pattern of repeat no-show disputes between these parties and no indication of abuse on either side that would require escalation.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02722-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 — no advisory covers Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 in this window. Under POL-NS-06(i) a MISSING traffic_advisory makes the accumulated-dwell limb unavailable, so the driver cannot claim accumulated dwell across separate in-geofence intervals. I do not rely on that limb; the driver's case rests on the platform's own wait-timer events and the recorded 6.7-minute wait.

The rider filed this dispute claiming 'I never saw the car' and was charged SGD 4.50. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION on a rider-filed dispute leaves the charge in place — the rider's claim is not supported by the evidence. But because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout, the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd of SGD 3.60, per POL-GEN-03's single exception.

I concede that the derived arrival block reports longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec of 0.0 and qualifying_fix_count of 0, meaning the exported trace does not itself contain fixes that pass the POL-NS-02 consecutive-in-radius test. I do not argue that the exported trace independently establishes the dwell. The driver's case rests instead on the platform's own wait-timer events in the trip record, which are PLATFORM_TELEMETRY records of the platform's full-resolution measurement, and on the absence of any admissible fix in the exported trace affirmatively placing the driver outside the arrival radius during the waiting window.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the $4.50 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, and no compensation is paid to the driver.

What the record shows. The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 19:11:37 and the platform's free-waiting timer started at 19:11:39 (EV-TRIP-02722, events driver_arrived and wait_timer_started); he cancelled at 19:18:19 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, a wait the trip record measures at 6.7 minutes. The fare ledger (EV-FARE-02722) shows $4.50 charged, payment status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd $0.00. The rider's own device (EV-GPS-02722, rider track) sat stationary about 895 m from the pickup pin for the whole window and sent no message.

Why the fee does not stand. A no-show fee is chargeable under POL-NS-01 only if all four limbs hold. Limb (a) holds (the trip record carries the 'arrived' event) and limb (d) holds (no boarding, driver-terminated under RIDER_NO_SHOW), which is what the driver's first claim correctly establishes. Limb (b) does not hold: POL-NS-02 deems the driver arrived only where the GPS trace contains at least three consecutive fixes, each reported with accuracy of 25 m or better, inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and the computed arrival block of EV-GPS-02722 reports 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes, a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds and 0 in-geofence intervals in which the driver held position. The trace is complete — 100 fixes, 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, max gap 0.0 seconds — so this test ran and found nothing qualifying; it did not fail for want of data. LIMB (b) therefore fails. Limb (c) fails with it: measured by that same test the in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 180 seconds in force for this trip (EV-TRIP-02722, platform_policy.free_wait_sec), and POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full on a 180-second shortfall whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded. Limb (c) is measured from GPS entry into the geofence, not from the driver's tap, so the recorded 6.7-minute wait cannot carry it.

The driver's wait-timer argument. The platform's wait-timer events do not stand in for the geofence test. POL-NS-12 makes a platform arrival event an independent carrier only where trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO; this trip's marker is BUTTON (a driver-pressed marker, EV-TRIP-02722), and POL-NS-12 says in terms that a BUTTON marker is not covered and remains subject to POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05. The driver's claim citing POL-NS-12 and the concession that the exported trace does not itself establish the dwell are answered together: the concession is correct, and because the BUTTON marker is not platform-confirmed the events it rests on cannot lift the failure of limb (b).

Why the driver is paid nothing. POL-NS-07 pays 80% compensation only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. The anti-farming guard does not trip — no_show_terminations_30d 1, completed_trips_30d 130, a ratio of 0.0077, below both the count of 4 and the rate of 0.08 — but clearing the guard only opens the door; with limb (b) failed there is no fee to take 80% of, so the claimed $3.60 payout is refused and no figure mirrors into amount_sgd. POL-NS-03 does not change this: it needs the driver stationary for the required dwell within 400 m of the pin but outside the radius, and the trace records no such run (longest_run_sec 0.0, run_count 0); in any event this pickup has 1 registered pickup point, so POL-NS-03(ii) goodwill could not arise.

The rider's own position. The rider track places the rider's device about 895 m from the pin (min 891.7 m, max 898.7 m, 75 fixes at 0.0 km/h), outside the 100 m STANDARD rider presence radius with 0 qualifying rider fixes, and the rider sent no chat message. POL-NS-04 therefore cannot exonerate the rider on its contact limb, and POL-NS-11 does not arise because the rider track is present and the limb is decidable rather than undecidable. None of this changes the fee: POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation fee regardless of the rider's presence, and the rider's statement 'I never saw the car' is not the ground of this ruling.

False-arrival question and referrals. POL-NS-05 would produce a false-arrival referral only if the trace placed the driver more than 300 m from the pin, or moving at 15 km/h or more, at the moment of the 19:11:37 marker. The record does not carry the driver's position or speed at that timestamp — the trace's raw minimum distance to the pin is 0.0 m, so the device did reach the pin at some point — and I will not infer a referral from an unresolved point. No other clause produces a referral, so referrals is empty. This is an open question a human reviewer may wish to examine on appeal; it does not change the money.

Escalation is not engaged. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08: no sampling gap over 120 seconds (max gap 0.0 s) and far more than six fixes across the window; one chat message, matching trip_record.chat_message_count 1, with message numbering intact; and the $4.50 ledger line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of $4.50, so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. No repeat-abuse pattern appears (rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d 0; disputes_with_counterparty_90d 0 on both sides) and the POL-NS-07 check does not trip, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged. POL-NS-09(b) is not engaged either: the apparent conflict between the arrival tap and the geofence test is resolved by POL-NS-01(c) and POL-NS-02 themselves, which make the GPS entry, not the tap, the test, so there is no unresolved contradiction on arrival for a reviewer to settle.

Evidence and confidence. The deciding fact — that the trace establishes neither an in-geofence arrival nor a 180-second dwell — rests on EV-GPS-02722 (weight 1.0), with the waiting period from EV-TRIP-02722 (weight 1.0) and the amount from EV-FARE-02722 (weight 1.0); the cap is therefore 1.0 and confidence is set at 0.80, above the 0.70 floor. EV-ADVIS-02722-01 (TRAFFIC_ADVISORY) is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT; its absence is itself citable and is why POL-NS-06(i) accumulation across separate in-geofence intervals was unavailable to the driver, and both sides' claims on that point are answered that way. The $4.50 refund is at or below the $8.00 automatic execution threshold, so it will execute on issue; the ruling is provisional and either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: this decides trip TRP-02722. The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged to the rider is refunded in full, and no payment is made to the driver.

WHY THE FEE DOES NOT STAND. POL-NS-01 charges a no-show fee only if all four of its limbs hold. Limb (b) requires the GPS trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence, and limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least the free waiting period in force — 180 seconds here (EV-TRIP-02722, platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). The driver's trace EV-GPS-02722 is complete and clean (100 fixes at a 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps, weight_multiplier 1.0), and its derived arrival block reports 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds. Under POL-NS-02 the driver is therefore deemed not to have arrived, limb (b) fails, and under POL-NS-06 the effective dwell of 0 seconds falls 180 seconds short of the free waiting period (shortfall_sec 180.0). The cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 (EV-FARE-02722, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is refunded in full. POL-NS-06 requires that refund whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered messages.

THE DRIVER'S CASE, ANSWERED. The 'I'm Here' tap at 19:11:37 and the driver's cancellation at 19:18:19 under RIDER_NO_SHOW do establish limbs (a) and (d), and the driver is right that the trace carries no POL-NS-08 defect — which is precisely why the absence finding is real and not the product of a gappy export. But all four limbs are required. The submission that the trace's minimum distance of 0.0 m shows the driver reached the pin is rejected: POL-NS-02's test reads consecutive fixes with reported accuracy of 25 m or better inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and the trace yields none; a trace-wide minimum distance is not that test, and the driver's own advocate concedes the exported trace does not establish the dwell. The reliance on POL-NS-12 fails on that clause's own terms: it covers only a platform-confirmed GPS_AUTO arrival, and this trip's arrival_marker is BUTTON — a driver-pressed marker, which POL-NS-12 expressly excludes; the wait-timer event therefore cannot stand in for the geofence measurement. The message 'im at the pickup point' at 19:11:57 (EV-CHAT-02722) shows the driver coordinating, but it is his own assertion and does not meet the arrival test. The counterparty statement 'I was at the pin for over six minutes' is an account with no weight_multiplier; it neither carries the arrival fact nor moves the confidence cap. POL-NS-07 compensation therefore does not arise (the computed SGD 3.60 is not payable), and in any event the anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d 1 against completed_trips_30d 130 is a rate of 0.0077, below the 0.08 threshold and below the count of 4. POL-NS-03 goodwill of SGD 2.25 is also not payable: registered_pickup_points is 1, so the pin-ambiguity limb (which needs 2 or more) is not engaged, and no stationary dwell within 400 m of the pin is established.

THE RIDER'S CASE, ANSWERED. The driver is correct that the rider's own track (75 fixes, all at 0.0 kph) sits about 895 m from the pin throughout and that rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0; the rider was not at the pickup point. That does not change the fee outcome, which POL-NS-06 gives regardless of rider presence, and POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on the contact limb because the rider sent no message. The submission that the arrival marker is FALSE under POL-NS-05, with a false-arrival referral, is rejected: no derived fact matches a GPS fix to the 19:11:37 timestamp, and trip-wide speeds of up to 62.8 km/h do not establish the driver's speed at the marker. That makes no difference to the money — the refund follows from POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 independently — and no clause therefore produces a referral. The rider's disclosure about EV-ADVIS-02722-01 is correct: it is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable; the missing artifact carries no fact and is not part of the confidence cap.

CONFIDENCE AND WEIGHT. The ruling rests on EV-GPS-02722 and EV-TRIP-02722, each at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and no deciding artifact is discounted. Confidence is 0.85.

EXECUTION AND APPEAL. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so it executes automatically on issue. This ruling was made without human review and is provisional; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

OPEN QUESTION FOR THE RECORD. The driver's track reports a minimum distance of 0.0 m to the pin, which the qualifying-fix test cannot reconcile with a zero-second in-geofence run; the platform's full-resolution stream would settle it. It does not change this outcome, which follows from POL-NS-02 as the exported trace stands.

The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on the 18 August trip is refunded to the rider in full. The driver receives no compensation.

Why the fee does not stand. POL-NS-01 allows a no-show fee only if all four of its conditions hold. Conditions (a) and (d) are met: the trip record shows the driver's 'I'm Here' tap at 19:11:37, and the trip was terminated at 19:18:19 with no boarding and reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. Conditions (b) and (c) are not met. Under POL-NS-02 a driver is deemed to have arrived only if the GPS trace holds at least three consecutive fixes, each accurate to 25 m or better, inside the 50 m arrival radius for a STANDARD pickup. The trace (EV-GPS-02722) computes zero qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds. That trace is clean — 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps and no clock skew — so the absence of a qualifying arrival is a real finding, not the product of a sparse export. Condition (c) needs a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force, 180 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec. The measured dwell is 0.0 seconds: a 180-second shortfall. POL-NS-06 therefore makes the fee unchargeable and refunds it in full, whether or not the rider was present.

Answering the driver. The platform wait-timer argument is rejected. POL-NS-12 makes the platform's arrival and wait-timer events an independent carrier only where arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO; this trip's marker is BUTTON. An arrival tap set by the driver records only that he tapped it, and POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the tap. The argument from the trace's minimum distance of 0.0 m is rejected: the derived arrival computation is authoritative and reports no in-geofence interval in which the driver held position, so passing over the pin is not holding at it. POL-NS-03 does not apply: there is no stationary dwell outside the arrival radius but within 400 m, and with one registered pickup point (registered_pickup_points = 1) its pin-ambiguity limb cannot be reached, so no goodwill or driver compensation arises. The driver's own concession that the exported trace does not itself establish the dwell is correct, but it does not save the fee, because POL-NS-12 is unavailable and no other carrier supports the wait. POL-NS-07 compensation is not payable: it operates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it does not. In any event the anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 1 against completed_trips_30d = 130, a rate of 0.008). The anti-escalation points on both profiles are accepted.

Answering the rider. Accepted: that there is no qualifying in-geofence fix (POL-NS-02); that the dwell shortfall is 180 seconds against the 180-second free waiting period (POL-NS-06); that the GPS export is complete so the absence of arrival is genuine; that the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02722-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable and no advisory carries any fact; that the fare line of SGD 4.50 reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect; and that neither profile raises a POL-NS-09(c) or (d) ground. The rider's claim that the rider's own track shows the rider waiting at the pin is only partly right: the device was stationary, but at roughly 895 m from the pin (mean 895.2 m, min 891.7 m, 0 qualifying fixes), outside the 100 m presence radius, so POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider and POL-NS-11 does not arise. That does not change the refund, which POL-NS-06 gives whether or not the rider was present. The request for a POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival referral is not granted: that limb fires only after the arrival marker is itself found false, which requires the driver's distance (over 300 m) or speed (15 km/h or more) at 19:11:37, and the record fixes neither. POL-NS-05 therefore cannot be run on this record and no clause produces a referral; the point is left here as an observation for the reader, not an instruction.

Confidence and next steps. The deciding fact — the driver's failure to establish the required in-geofence dwell — is carried by EV-GPS-02722 at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0 and confidence is set at 0.88. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged (confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the two records do not contradict each other on a fact no clause resolves, the counterparty-dispute counters are zero, the anti-farming check does not trip, and the deciding evidence is not impaired). The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so it executes on issue. Both parties may appeal under POL-GEN-04.
